data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin Crack as Trump Says 'We Don't Need a Deal With Iran': Analyst Warns BTC's Correction Could Deepen
data.description: Leading cryptocurrencies plunged deeper on Thursday as investors weighed President Donald Trump’s latest remarks on Iran.Crypto Market TumblesBitcoin fell below $71,000 for the first time in nearly three months, while Ethereum slipped below $2,000 as major cryptocurrencies faced heavy selling press…
